nsse17.title: Taurus × Pisces: the blanket and the waterworks.
nsse17.caption: Some people cry at the sad part. Some cry at the opening titles. Let the steady one hold you, and let them say the soft thing out loud. Tag your movie-night person.

nsse18.title: Cancer × Scorpio: the shell and the vault.
nsse18.caption: Two people saying "fine" can drift a long way apart. Say the real thing, go first sometimes, and agree that "fine?" means "tell me more."

nsse19.title: Gemini × Libra: the invites and the yes-es.
nsse19.caption: Saying yes to every invite can leave no time for each other. Check in, decline kindly, and remember the walk home counts too. Save this for party season.

nsse20.title: Sagittarius × Capricorn: the season handover.
nsse20.caption: Adventure and planning make a good team when both get a turn. Finish one thing, keep one wild day, and plan the next trip together.

nsse21.title: Cancer × Leo: the photo and the family.
nsse21.caption: Holiday photos get serious fast. Leave room for everyone, ask for the photo you want, and keep the blurry one where everyone is laughing.

nsse22.title: Libra × Pisces: the hike neither of them wanted.
nsse22.caption: Pretending to love a date to keep the peace still costs you something. Gentle honesty is how you find the plan you both enjoy.

nsse23.title: Scorpio × Capricorn: who says it first.
nsse23.caption: Waiting for them to say it first can turn into waiting forever. Feelings don't need a deadline, just a little courage. Who said it first in your story?

nsse24.title: Aries × Aquarius: the snowman and the snow-bot.
nsse24.caption: One of you wants it done, one wants it different. Ask about their idea, join in before it's perfect, and build the odd version together.

nsse25.title: Taurus × Leo: two fixed signs, one couch.
nsse25.caption: Two people who both know where they like to sit. Share the blanket, give up the good cushion now and then, and take turns choosing.
